hero_kpi_rationale: The Renewable Energy segment delivered record results in Q1 2026, offsetting weakness in other business areas and representing a differentiated growth lever in SCA's portfolio.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products.
kpis.description: The decline is attributed to lower selling prices and negative currency effects.
kpis.signal: Decline of 8% year-over-year due to prices and currency headwinds.

kpis.name: EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: EBITDA divided by revenue, measuring operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin declined from 32.0% to 23.4% due to material costs and currency effects.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit before interest and taxes, after operating expenses.
kpis.description: Combined impact of prices, costs, and currency on profitability.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow improved due to better working capital management.
kpis.signal: Improved cash generation despite declining profit.

kpis.name: Net Debt to EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures the company's ability to repay debt using EBITDA.
kpis.description: The ratio increased from 1.5x to 2.0x year-over-year, reflecting higher debt or lower EBITDA.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in financial health due to increased debt.

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Segment Result
kpis.explanation: Performance of the wind and bioenergy segment, a growth driver.
kpis.description: Driven by elevated electricity prices and the commissioning of the Fasikan wind farm.
kpis.signal: Record historical performance for the renewable energy segment.

risks.title: Volatility in wood and pulp prices
risks.score_rationale: Major implicit risk embedded in multi-segment revenue structure (Forest, Wood, Pulp, Containerboard) with highly volatile EBITDA margins: Pulp 2.5% Q1 2026 vs 16.5% Q1 2025; Wood 3.8% vs 15.8%. Measured language but financial data reveals critical exposure to commodity price cycles.

risks.title: Dependence on demand for containerboard and packaging paper
risks.score_rationale: Containerboard and Pulp represent approximately 70% of industrial revenues (1,623 + 1,735 SEKm out of 4,740 SEKm). Declining Containerboard sales in Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 (-3.6%) and Pulp (-16.3%) indicate demand sensitivity. Downward trend over four quarters.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and trade barriers
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in opening remarks: 'Tariffs, increased trade barriers and geopolitical turmoil are creating uncertainty and risk affecting market conditions going forward.' Direct language and positioned as primary risk. Geographically diversified revenues (Asia 12%, Rest of Europe 35%) amplify exposure.

risks.title: Volatility in biological forestry asset valuation
risks.score_rationale: Forestry assets: 104.1 billion SEK (70% of total assets). Valuation based on DCF model sensitive to discount rates, timber prices, and harvesting costs. Biological asset value changes: +427m Q1 2026 vs +445m Q1 2025. Complex methodology using three-year average pricing.

risks.title: Environmental compliance and forestry management risks
risks.score_rationale: Environmental provisions of 113 SEKm (vs 125 SEKm end of 2025) indicate restoration and remediation obligations. Management of 277-279 million m³ of forests in Sweden and the Baltics subject to increasing regulations (EU Green Deal, FSC/PEFC certifications). Implicit but material risk for a major forestry operator.

risks.title: Dependence on energy costs and electricity prices
risks.score_rationale: Renewable Energy segment generated 38 SEKm in revenue (Q1 2026) but also represents partial hedge. Electricity derivatives present on balance sheet (102 SEKm in hedging assets). Paper and cardboard industry highly energy-intensive. Volatility in energy costs impacts margins: Containerboard 6.0% Q1 2026 vs 24.8% Q2 2025.

risks.title: Capital intensity and industrial investment risks
risks.score_rationale: Net CAPEX Q1 2026: -245 SEKm (vs -513 SEKm Q4 2025). Significant non-current assets (forests plus mills). Weak ROCE: 1.9% Q1 2026 (vs 3.9% Q1 2025), negative industrial ROCE (-3.3%). Major investments required for modernization and decarbonization in context of compressed margins.

risks.title: Energy transition and decarbonization of operations
risks.score_rationale: Paper and cardboard industry under increasing pressure to reduce carbon emissions. Renewable Energy segment (38 SEKm revenue) signals transition strategy, but scale of required investments not quantified in this filing. EU regulations (ETS, Carbon Border Adjustment) will increase costs. Measured language but represents major structural risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in recent reports. The company does not position AI as a strategic or operational lever.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation in the report.
Cited innovations concern forestry resource management and renewable energy.
No AI-related products or services are mentioned.
